title: NBA TV to Reveal 2019-20 Kia NBA Most Valuable Player Winner, Today, Friday, Sept. 18, at 2 p.m. ET
htmlContent:
﻿ -- wp:paragraph -->

NBA TV will reveal this season's Kia NBA Most Valuable Player winner later today, Friday, Sept. 18, at 2 p.m. ET. Coverage will be hosted by Ernie Johnson. 

The Kia NBA MVP finalists in alphabetical order are:

Giannis Antetokounmpo, Milwaukee Bucks
James Harden, Houston Rockets﻿ >LeBron James, Los Angeles Lakers

Awards voting, from a global panel of sportswriters and broadcasters, was based on games played from the start of the regular season through March 11 and did not include “seeding games.”
